Apply a project's pending migrations

Source: R/api.R
projet_migrer.Rd

What opening the project in the application does: set aside indicators computed under an older indicator direction (renamed data/indicators.perime-v<n>-<date>.parquet, never deleted; the project goes back to draft and must be recomputed) and create the management units when they are missing (one unit per parcel; unreadable unit files are moved to data/ug_sauvegarde_<date>/ first).

Usage

projet_migrer(id)

Arguments

id

Project id.

Value

The new projet_etat(), invisibly.

See also

Other api_hors_interface: parcelles_commune(), projet_calculer(), projet_creer(), projet_etat(), projet_gpkg(), projet_lire(), projet_rapport(), projets_lister()
